observations.why: Domain jargon (QuantumDB, analytics pipeline) used natively without glossing — the document's baseline register, establishing the technical signature.
Flat instrumental delivery: quantitative claims stacked without hedging, intensification, or audience-directed energy — a strong instantiation of the matter-of-fact pole.
Arrow-notation shorthand for a migration path, used natively as if self-explanatory — technical register performed through typographic convention rather than prose.

mints.name: TechnicalShorthandAsRegister
mints.title: arrow-notation and jargon shorthand standing in for full sentences
mints.frame: Is the register here carried by typographic or notational shorthand rather than by grammatical prose — and does that shorthand itself signal the technical register?
